@polyspec/kit: import { readdirSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; const dir = 'node_modules/@polyspec/kit/scripts/kit/'; const modules = readdirSync(dir).filter(name => name.endsWith('.mjs') && /^export /m.test(readFileSync(dir + name, 'utf8'))); for (const name of modules) await import('@polyspec/kit/' + name); const { makeVenv } = await import('@polyspec/kit/python-venv.mjs'); if (typeof makeVenv !== 'function') throw new Error('@polyspec/kit/python-venv.mjs exports no makeVenv'); console.log('imported ' + modules.length + ' modules of @polyspec/kit');
